$description: Design tokens — single source of truth. Material 3 (Material You / M3 Expressive) role architecture on a neutral canvas anchored to the reference site in BOTH color schemes: light surface #ECECEC and dark surface #1E1E1E (exact theretriever.app body backgrounds, extracted from live DOM with prefers-color-scheme emulation 2026-10-22 — the reference is dark-first: :root carries the dark palette, light arrives via @media (prefers-color-scheme: light)). Pure-neutral gray ramp, ink primary, mono schematic voice. The hero dot texture is the EXACT reference animated canvas wave (see dotwave). Compiled to src/styles/tokens.css via `npm run tokens` (scripts/build-tokens.mjs). NEVER hand-edit tokens.css.

$extensions.com.material.material3: color roles, neutral baseline (canvas = reference #ECECEC, primary = ink)

dark scheme color roles, anchored to the EXACT reference dark palette (theretriever.app :root defaults, verified live 2026-10-22 via headless-Chrome dark emulation + network CSS fetch): surface = ref --bg #1E1E1E, surfaceContainerLowest = ref --panel #262626, onSurface = ref --text #FFFFFF, onSurfaceVariant = ref --text-2 #9A9A9A, outlineVariant = ref --separator #343434, tertiary = ref --amber #D69957. Container ramp steps (low/container/high/highest) are tuned darker than M3 defaults so on-surface-variant #9A9A9A keeps >= 4.5:1 on every container (AA) — enforced by the A1 dark contrast gates. inverseSurface stays dark (#262626) on purpose: the hero window chrome is dark in BOTH schemes, matching the reference's dark window. Filled buttons invert exactly like the reference's .btn.primary (background var(--text), color var(--bg)): white fill + #1E1E1E ink in dark. Emitted as @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root { ... } } — same trigger the reference uses (inverted: the reference is dark-first with a light override; behavior is identical because prefers-color-scheme always resolves to light OR dark).

mdRefState.$description: Material 3 state-layer opacities applied over the base color with the content color as veil.

mdSysElevation.$description: M3 elevation levels 1-3 (tailored: UI is flat; elevation only on floating windows and featured cards).

mdSysShape.$description: M3 shape scale, tailored flat: corners stay small (schematic voice); medium = reference card radius (12px); full reserved for pills.

mdSysTypography.$description: M3 type scale, tailored: display/headline keep retriever-like negative tracking; label roles render in the mono schematic voice.

fontFamilyBody.$value: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

fontFamilyLabel.$value: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

mdSysMotion.$description: Material 3 motion tokens (duration + easing). Reveals use emphasized-decelerate.

layout.$description: Retriever-derived layout rhythm (extracted from reference, kept as custom tokens).

dotwave.$description: Hero dot WAVE — the reference's actual hero pattern, verified by live headless-Chrome forensics on 2026-10-22 (tool-results/ref-forensics/report.json): an animated <canvas class="wave"> painted by public/wave.js (byte-exact port of theretriever.app wave.js?v=30, md5 d3e409c930440ad2b1763632c75814c8). 48x26 dot grid, sinusoidal phase c*0.32 + r*0.2 - t*0.9, vertical oscillation +-0.3*dy, radius (1.5 + k*2.5)/2, alpha 0.04 + k*0.14, color from the canvas CSS 'color'. Hero-only: the hero is the ONLY dotted surface. Values are the reference hero's exact canvas data-attributes.

decay.$description: Verified reference dot-matrix illustrations (scene 'What deleted means'), reused as CONTENT figures in the About states triptych — not background textures, so the hero-only dotted-surface rule holds. Byte-exact copies: public/assets/decay-{1,2,3}.svg; pristine archive + provenance: docs/reference-assets/ (md5s recorded there, fetched 2026-10-22).
